Piccadilly.reason: PICCADILLY LINE: From 0200 Saturday 26 and all day Sunday 27 September (including Friday and Saturday Night Tube), no service between Cockfosters and Uxbridge. Trains continue to operate between Acton Town and Heathrow. Use DISTRICT LINE trains between Central London and Acton Town / Ealing Common and METROPOLITAN LINE trains between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge.
